exposure.needed: whether the operator filters or parses cert-manager logs using grep or similar tools, which is not visible in any static configuration

consequence.statement: Operators who filter cert-manager logs using grep or similar tools may find their filters no longer match, because some log lines have changed format after more structured logging information was added.
consequence.remediation: Review and update any grep-based or text-based log filtering and parsing to account for the new structured log line format.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, so some log lines have changed format, which may affect operators who filter logs with grep or similar tools.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
